name: webdata-tools-mcp
description: Ten web-data tools for agents: jobs, hiring signals, news, reviews, Reddit, contacts, real estate, Shopify.
long_description: Runs ready-made Apify Actors (published by tacps126) on your own Apify account and returns clean JSON. Covers job postings from career pages, LinkedIn and Indeed, hiring signals, Google News, Trustpilot and app-store reviews, Reddit mentions, website contact details, German property listings and Shopify products. You pay Apify per result (about $1-3 per 1,000); every call has a spend cap.

tools.name: find_hiring_companies
tools.description: Find companies hiring for given roles

tools.name: get_company_jobs
tools.description: Get all open jobs from company career pages

tools.name: get_trustpilot_reviews
tools.description: Get Trustpilot reviews and company rating

tools.name: get_app_reviews
tools.description: Get App Store and Google Play reviews

tools.name: find_website_contacts
tools.description: Find emails, phones and social profiles on websites

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: From Apify Console > Settings > API & Integrations. Actors run on your account.

max_charge_usd.title: Maximum spend per tool call (USD)
max_charge_usd.description: Apify stops a run when this is reached.
